title: Over a Cohen–Macaulay local ring a finite module has a finite free resolution ending in a maximal Cohen–Macaulay module
statement:
Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of finite Krull dimension $d$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] with $\operatorname{depth}(R)\ge d$ [def-weil-pbc-depth] (that is, $\mathfrak m$ contains an $R$-regular sequence of length $d$; such an $R$ is Cohen–Macaulay). Let $M$ be a nonzero finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $e=\operatorname{depth}(M)$. Then $e\le d$, and there is an exact sequence of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]

$$
0\to K\to F_{d-e-1}\to\cdots\to F_0\to M\to 0
$$

in which every $F_i$ is a finite free $R$-module ($F_i\cong R^{\oplus n_i}$ for some integer $n_i\ge0$) and $K$ is a finite $R$-module which is either $0$ or maximal Cohen–Macaulay, i.e. $\operatorname{depth}(K)=d$. (When $e=d$ there are no $F_i$ and the sequence reads $0\to K\to M\to0$, i.e. $K\cong M$.)

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NG (lemma-mcm-resolution, line 25411), with Lemma Tag 00NE (lemma-dimension-shift, line 25396), Definition Tag 00NF (definition-maximal-CM, line 25135) and, for $e\le d$, Lemma Tag 00LK (lemma-bound-depth, line 17814)

proof.text: Bound depth(M) by its support dimension with depth_le_supportDim, then by ringKrullDim R=d with Mathlib Module.supportDim_le_ringKrullDim. Since d is finite, write depth(M)=e with e a natural number and deduce e≤d.
Apply the arbitrary-length finite free sequence construction at k=d-e to M.
Apply the depth-shift lemma to this sequence with hdim, hcm, depth(M)=e and e≤d. Combine its finite, zero-or-depth-d conclusion for K with the sequence data.

Proof in seven steps: e <= d from 00LK (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-depth-le-support-dimension) and dim Supp(M) <= dim R; free modules R^n (n >= 1) have depth >= d (written out from the definitions); induction on k = d - e with the explicit claim P(k) (nonzero finite N of depth d - k has 0 -> K -> F_{k-1} -> ... -> F_0 -> N -> 0, F_i finite free, K nonzero finite of depth d), base K = N; inductive step: surjection R^n -> N, kernel K_1 finite (existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite) and nonzero (else N free of depth >= d), depth K_1 = e' + 1 from 00LX (2) and (3) (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-depth-in-ses; 00NE alone gives only depth K_1 > e', which does not give the exact length d - e), then splicing. The proof gives K != 0, so the 'K = 0' alternative of the statement never occurs for M != 0 (the source gap recorded for 00NG is closed).
